paper_title: Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse
caption: Distribution of articles across political leanings of the outlets
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of articles across different political leanings of media outlets. The chart is divided into four slices, representing "Left bias," "Right bias," "Left center bias," and "Questionable source." The slices are colored blue, orange, green, and red respectively. The "Right bias" slice occupies approximately 30.0% (30), while the "Left bias" slice represents around 28.0% (28). The "Left center bias" slice is approximately 22.0% (20), and the "Questionable source" slice accounts for roughly 20.0% (20). Percentage labels are presented directly within each slice. A legend is not present. The slices appear arranged with the largest values on the right side of the chart, descending in size as one moves counterclockwise.
